newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Gunmen kill five in Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill five in Colombian capital.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot and killed five people early on Saturday in execution-style murders in a working-class district of the Colombian capital, police said.

The five victims, all men aged between 21 and 35, were shot in the back of the neck alongside railway tracks that cut through the San Cristobal neighbourhood at the northern end of the city before dawn, the Metropolitan Police department said.
It said three of the victims were identified as construction workers and had no criminal records or any apparent links to organised crime.
Two weeks ago seven youths were killed by unidentified gunmen wielding automatic weapons in Chia, a northwest suburb of the capital.
